context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 98 tested 5 revenue/billing features. All endpoints working: (1) GET /api/late-payment/predictions returns risk predictions from real invoice data, (2) GET /api/late-payment/overdue-invoices returns overdue invoices with days_overdue, (3) POST /api/late-payment/send-reminder sends email via Resend (requires to_email), (4) POST /api/late-payment/send-confirmation sends payment confirmation, (5) GET /api/late-payment/reminder-history returns sent reminders, (6) GET /api/usage-billing/overview returns usage plans with MRR breakdown, (7) GET /api/client-budget/overview returns budgets with category breakdown, (8) GET /api/revenue-forecast/dashboard returns MRR/ARR forecast with churn risks. Frontend pages: /late-payment (3 tabs: Predictions, Overdue, History + Send Reminder dialog), /usage-billing (summary cards + client plans table), /client-budget (budget cards with progress bars + category breakdown), /revenue-forecast (MRR area chart + monthly projections table + churn risks table).

late_payment_predictions.response: Returns predictions array with risk scoring (high/medium/low), outstanding_amount, probability_pct

overdue_invoices.response: Returns overdue array with days_overdue, balance_due, summary with count and total

send_reminder.response: Sends email via Resend, requires to_email in request body

send_confirmation.response: Sends payment confirmation email, optional cc_team flag

reminder_history.response: Returns array of sent reminders with sent_at, client_name, email_status

usage_billing_overview.response: Returns plans with device_count, current_mrr, overage_amount; summary with total_mrr

client_budget_overview.response: Returns budgets with annual_budget, ytd_spent, categories breakdown

revenue_forecast_dashboard.response: Returns 12-month forecast array, churn_risks array, summary with current_mrr/arr

frontend_late_payment_page.details: 3 tabs (Predictions, Overdue, History), summary cards, Send Reminder dialog with email input

frontend_usage_billing_page.details: 4 summary cards (MRR, Clients, Avg Per Device, Overages), Client Usage Plans table

frontend_client_budget_page.details: 4 summary cards, 8 budget cards with progress bars and category breakdown

frontend_revenue_forecast_page.details: 5 summary cards, MRR area chart, Monthly Projections table, Churn Risk Clients table
